record.paper_title: Banach spaces and Ramsey Theory: some open problems
record.original_question: Does every Banach space of density greater than c, and does every reflexive Banach space of density greater than ℵ_1, contain an infinite sub-symmetric basic sequence?

evidence.quote: Problem 21. Does every (respectively, every reflexive) Banach space of density > c (respectively, of density > ℵ1) has an infinite sub-symmetric basic sequence?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Schauder basic sequence $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ in a Banach space is called sub-symmetric if it is unconditional and equivalent to each of its infinite subsequences; equivalently, there is a constant $C\ge 1$ such that for every strictly increasing sequence $n_1<n_2<\cdots$ of positive integers, every choice of signs $\varepsilon_i\in\{-1,+1\}$, and every finitely supported sequence of scalars $(a_i)$, 
$$C^{-1}\Big\|\sum_i a_i x_i\Big\|\le \Big\|\sum_i \varepsilon_i a_i x_{n_i}\Big\|\le C\Big\|\sum_i a_i x_i\Big\|.$$
The density of a Banach space $X$ is the smallest cardinality of a norm-dense subset of $X$. Let $\mathfrak c=2^{\aleph_0}$ denote the cardinality of the continuum and $\aleph_1$ the first uncountable cardinal.

(a) Does every Banach space whose density is strictly greater than $\mathfrak c$ contain an infinite sub-symmetric basic sequence?

(b) Does every reflexive Banach space whose density is strictly greater than $\aleph_1$ contain an infinite sub-symmetric basic sequence?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a definitive resolution of either part of this problem on the existence of infinite sub-symmetric basic sequences in Banach spaces of large density. The problem appears in lists of open problems in Banach space Ramsey theory, but no published solution was located that confirms or refutes either statement, so the current status is unclear.

status_evidence.title: Complexity and homogeneity in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing structural Ramsey-type questions in Banach spaces, including subsymmetric sequences, without a recorded solution to the density>c / density>aleph_1 problem.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the question is recorded in surveys of the area.

status_evidence.title: Symmetrically separated sequences in the unit sphere of a Banach space
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses symmetric/subsymmetric-type sequences in Banach spaces of various densities, but does not settle existence of sub-symmetric basic sequences in spaces of density > c or reflexive spaces of density > aleph_1.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on subsymmetric/symmetric sequences does not resolve the stated question.
